answer: A hostile operator running 178 aliases therefore needs 139 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in tundra, expire in juniper, and ledge lists each expiry. A farm of 701 identities would post 3881 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
